Description
Gold has been a store of value for thousands of years and has proven to be a safe investment in times of economic uncertainty. Bullion Trading LLC presents the 1-gram gold bar from Valcambi, a renowned name in the precious metals industry. The Valcambi Suisse refinery is well known for its quality and craftsmanship, and this bar is a perfect example of the Valcambi standards.
The Valcambi 1-
gram gold bar
with .9999 pure gold represents elegance and premium design available at Bullion Trading LLC at an affordable rate. It comes with an assay card to ensure the authenticity and purity of the bar.
Design of 1 Gram Valcambi Gold Bar (New w/ Assay)
Valcambi 1-gram gold bar reflects high quality and value with its simple and elegant design. The reverse side of the Valcambi 1-gram gold bar features a rotating square Valcambi Suisse logo along with engraving weight, metal content, and purity of the bar. At the bottom of the bar features the unique serial number and assayer’s mark.
On the reverse side of the bars, you will find “Valcambi Suisse” written simply and perfectly. These bars are minted ingots with rounded corners and raised edges to ensure authenticity and quality. The main features and specifications of this product are as follows.
Main Highlights of 1 Gram Valcambi Gold Bar (New w/ Assay)
Contains 1 Gram (0.03215 Troy oz) of .9999 pure gold.
Assayer’s mark included on obverse
Obverse design features the Valcambi logo and identifying markers.
Reverse bears the corporate name for Valcambi.
Each bar has an individual serial number.
